Version info, licenses, and core tech
To provide a simple, reliable, and secure dialer experience without compromising user privacy.
Secure Dialer is a privacy-focused communication tool designed to put you in control of your data. All functions occur exclusively on your device.
At Secure Dialer, we prioritize your privacy.
Your contacts, call logs, and personal history are never transmitted to our servers.
Information is used only for core dialer functions: Contacts mapping, Call history display, and Microphone access during calls.
We do not share your data with any third parties.
Ensure app is up to date & secure
Check and update Secure Dialer directly from official F-Droid or stable mirrors.
You are using the latest official cryptographic build of Secure Dialer.
Secure Dialer is up to date! Version v%1$s (Stable Release)

Secure Dialer is 100% free, open-source, ad-free, and privacy-first. If you find this app helpful, consider contributing code, submitting translations, or supporting the development of free and secure tools.

Secure Dialer requires access to your Contacts and Call Logs to display call history, identify incoming callers, and allow dialing. All data is processed 100% locally on your device and is never uploaded or shared.

Banner appears only when battery is restricted
When Secure Dialer is your Default Phone App, Android gives incoming ringers and active calls foreground protection. Keeping Optimized battery is safe on Pixel, Motorola, Nothing, and stock Android.
Some manufacturer ROMs aggressively close background components, delay lock-screen call screens, or miss reminders unless Autostart and Unrestricted battery are enabled.
Unrestricted battery helps prevent OEM task killers from pausing long background call recordings or terminating audio services mid-call.
